parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the basic GA instance belongs. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the basic GA instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en:
The state of the basic GA instance. Valid values:

init: The basic GA instance is being initialized.
active: The basic GA instance is available.
configuring: The basic GA instance is being configured.
binding: The basic GA instance is being associated.
unbinding: The basic GA instance is being disassociated.
deleting: The basic GA instance is being deleted.
finacialLocked: The basic GA instance is locked due to overdue payments
parameters.help_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的状态。取值：

init：初始化。

active：可用。

configuring：配置中。

binding：绑定中。

unbinding：解绑中。

deleting：删除中。

finacialLocked：欠费锁定
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the basic GA instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例所属资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The key of tag N of the basic GA instance. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys
fields.help_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的标签键。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

您最多可输入20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of tag N of the basic GA instance. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`.

You can specify up to 20 tag values
fields.help_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的标签值。一旦输入该值，不可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

您最多可输入20个标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags of the GA instance
parameters.help_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的标签。

您最多可输入20个标签
parameters.name: tag
